race.description: May Racing Carnival Now On Sale Mdn Plate
race.comment: Tricky. ALMORINA (8) is an Almanzor mare on debut for the Symon Wilde yard who looks to have jumped out quite well. The stable are always dangerous at home and the raced brigade haven't shown a stack. PRESTIGE ERICK (5) ran a solid race first up at Kilmore when fourth with improvement to come. This trip should suit better, he'll just need a good ride from the gate. SEMPER AUGUSTUS (9) was a $16 chance on debut here but ran well for second, beaten two lengths. Have to respect now for the local yard. OCEAN SURGE (12) has just been fair in two runs to date but is open to improvement as is STOMPING GROUND (13) who was okay fresh.
